links.outcome: Formal training, supervision, and policies for conversational AI use among residents
links.effect: Formal training, supervision, and institutional policies appeared limited, while 58.1% of residents used conversational AI in the operating room.
links.quote: Formal training, supervision, and institutional policies appeared limited.

links.outcome: Prevalence of conversational AI use in the OR with limited institutional policies
links.effect: Operating room use was reported by 58.1% (95% CI 47.6-68.0%) of 86 residents; institutional policies appeared limited.
links.quote: Conversational AI use in the operating room was reported by 58.1% (95% CI 47.6-68.0%).

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of anesthesiology residents evaluating the prevalence, patterns, and determinants of conversational AI use during clinical practice in the operating room.
